ai.title: system-prompt: Clarify editfile vs code block usage
ai.summary: backend/src/system-prompt.ts updated editing_instructions to distinguish between applying edits and displaying code. <edit_file> blocks are now explicitly described as immediately applied, while code intended for display only must use markdown ``` tags. Comment guidance refined to prohibit edit-related comments (e.g. "// Add this line") rather than just excessive comments.

eli5.text: The instructions that guide how the assistant edits code files have been clarified so there is no longer confusion between making an edit and just showing code. When the assistant wants to actually change a file, it still must use special blocks that get applied automatically and immediately. But if the assistant only wants to display code for you to read without changing anything, it must now use plain text markers instead of the edit blocks, which previously could accidentally modify files. Additionally, the rules about comments during edits have been tightened to prohibit comments that describe the edit itself, like 'Add this line', rather than simply discouraging excessive comments in general.

ai.title: Update referral message in npm-app client
ai.summary: Referral message updated in `npm-app/src/client.ts` to explicitly state credit bonus. Replaces generic wording with `CREDITS_REFERRAL_BONUS` constant and specific per-friend/month detail. Affects CLI output when `referralLink` is present.

eli5.text: The referral message shown in the command-line tool now clearly states you earn a set number of credits each month for every friend who signs up through your referral link. If you're signed in and have a referral link, the tool prints this updated wording instead of the old generic line. The concrete credit-per-friend-per-month amount is now spelled out in the message itself. It is live today.

ai.title: Move initial project context to worker thread
ai.summary: Initial project context generation now runs in `worker_threads` via new `worker-script-project-context.ts`, decoupling it from main thread startup. `project-files.ts` adds `initProjectFileContextWithWorker` which spawns worker, passes `dir`, caches result, terminates worker. `index.ts` calls worker init instead of `getProjectFileContext([], {})` and removes `await readyPromise` before CLI construction, so user input no longer blocks on version check or fingerprint. `getProjectFileContext` signature changed to accept `projectRoot` as first arg, propagated to `client.ts` call sites.

eli5.text: The assistant now loads your project information in the background instead of making you wait before you can start typing. When you open a project, the assistant can take your questions right away rather than pausing to check its version or scan your files first. This means less waiting time between opening the tool and being able to ask for help. The change is live today for anyone running the latest version.

ai.title: Bump manicode to 1.0.90
ai.summary: Version bump in npm-app/package.json from 1.0.89 to 1.0.90. No functional or API changes.

eli5.text: The application was updated and is now running a new release that fixes a few minor issues. The most notable improvement is that initial project context generation now runs in a separate worker thread, which should improve responsiveness when starting new tasks. The update also includes changes to referral messages, login copy, footer text, and various minor backend adjustments. The new version is live today.

ai.title: Update menu. Plug referrals after login
ai.summary: CLI menu and post-login output now highlight referral rewards using `CREDITS_REFERRAL_BONUS`. Login success message appends a referral link. Menu prompt examples updated to encourage feature building and integration via documentation URLs. Changes confined to `npm-app/src/client.ts` and `npm-app/src/menu.ts`.

eli5.text: When you sign in, the welcome message now also shows how many credits you can earn by inviting friends, along with a link to share. The menu you see when you open the tool has friendlier suggestions for what to ask, like building a feature or writing a script, and it points to documentation URLs for more help. These changes are live today for anyone who signs in or opens the menu.

ai.title: Simplify login copy and fix GitHub button casing
ai.summary: Login page copy simplified: title changed from 'Confirm cli login' to 'Login', description reduced to 'Continue to sign in to the Manicode CLI.' with phishing warning commented out. Sign-in button now renders 'GitHub' instead of 'Github' for provider casing. Scope: web/src/app/login/page.tsx, web/src/components/sign-in/sign-in-button.tsx.

eli5.text: When you click to sign in through the login screen, the button now correctly shows 'GitHub' instead of 'Github', matching the proper spelling of the service. The text on the login page was also simplified: the title now just says 'Login' instead of 'Confirm cli login', and the description tells you to continue signing in to the Manicode CLI. The old extra message about phishing is still there in the code but no longer shows on the screen. These are small wording and display fixes, so if you looked, you'd just see slightly cleaner, more correctly spelled text on the login page and buttons.

ai.title: Update footer text and Discord link label
ai.summary: Footer component in `web/src/components/footer.tsx` updated. Removed "coded with 🤖" text. Changed Discord link label from "(Keep in touch!)" to "Join our Discord!". Scope limited to web footer UI.

eli5.text: When you visit the website, the very bottom of the page no longer shows the little robot heart line next to the copyright; instead it just shows the year and the Discord link written as "Join our Discord!" rather than the old "(Keep in touch!)". If you scroll to the bottom of any page on the site, you'll see the footer looks a touch cleaner and the link tells you exactly what clicking it does. It's live for everyone visiting the site today.

ai.title: Update Freebuff landing page copy and CTA layout
ai.summary: Replaced legacy Manicode branding with Freebuff-focused copy on `web/src/app/page.tsx`. Updated hero tagline to emphasize natural language codebase editing and terminal command execution. Restructured CTA placement by moving the npm install command to the hero section and replacing the bottom button with a 'Get Started Coding with AI' link.

eli5.text: The Freebuff homepage now greets visitors with updated messaging that highlights editing code in plain language and running terminal commands quickly, and the install instructions have been moved up into the hero area so they're the first thing you see. The previous bottom button that linked to the npm package has been replaced with a 'Get Started Coding with AI' link in the same lower section. If you landed on the page today, you'd notice the branding and tagline no longer mention legacy Manicode copy, and the call-to-action flow has shifted from a button to a prominent inline command snippet at the top.

ai.title: Remove pb-12 from hero section, reflow startup tagline
ai.summary: Removed pb-12 utility class from hero section container in web/src/app/page.tsx. Reflowed YC startup tagline JSX text across lines. Internal UI styling and formatting change.

eli5.text: The homepage's main banner area lost some extra spacing below it, and the text describing the startup's background was adjusted to read more smoothly across lines. You'd notice the tagline line breaks slightly differently, but the overall look and content stay the same. This affects only the internal appearance of the website and requires no action from anyone.
